name: Clickbait Curse
hook: Scrub the timeline before the algorithm catches you mid-sneeze
tagline: A sweaty creator fights to maintain a hyper-edited shocked face thumbnail while YouTube's random frame selector rolls through hideous unflattering pauses. Cash out to publish a 10/10 viral banger and bank the viewcount. Crash out and the algorithm locks in a cursed double-chin mid-blink frame forever.
